name: NSKFDC General Term Loan
description: Term loan for Safai Karamcharis and their dependents for income-generating activities. Loan up to ₹15 lakh with concessional interest.
subsidy_info: 1% interest rebate for women beneficiaries. 0.5% rebate for timely repayment.

name: Stand-Up India
description: Bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore for SC/ST and Women entrepreneurs to set up greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, or trading.
subsidy_info: No subsidy. Margin money of up to 25% can be from eligible central/state schemes.

name: MUDRA Shishu
description: Micro-finance for very small businesses. Loan up to ₹50,000 under Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana for income-generating activities.

name: MUDRA Kishore
description: Loans from ₹50,000 to ₹5 lakh for growing businesses under Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana.

name: MUDRA Tarun
description: Loans from ₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh for established businesses seeking expansion under Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana.

name: PMEGP
description: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme. Loans for new micro-enterprises in manufacturing (up to ₹50 lakh) or service/business (up to ₹20 lakh) with government subsidy on project cost.
subsidy_info: SC/ST category: 35% subsidy on project cost in urban areas, 35% in rural areas. General category: 15% urban, 25% rural. Projects above ₹10L (manufacturing) or ₹5L (service) require 8th standard education.

name: Venture Capital Fund for SC
description: Equity or quasi-equity funding for SC entrepreneurs with viable business plans. For projects requiring ₹50 lakh to ₹15 crore. Operated through NSFDC.
subsidy_info: Equity investment — no interest. Returns through business growth and exit.

name: NSFDC Education Loan
description: Concessional education loan for SC students pursuing professional and technical higher education in India or abroad. Up to ₹40 Lakh at 6.5% interest.
subsidy_info: Concessional 6.5% interest rate. Moratorium period covers course duration plus 6 months.

name: NSFDC Term Loan
description: Concessional term loan for income-generating activities exclusively for Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs. Financing projects costing up to ₹50 Lakh through State Channelizing Agencies.
subsidy_info: Concessional interest rate provided through State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs).

name: NSFDC Micro Credit Finance
description: Micro credit for small-scale income-generating activities by SC individuals. Maximum project cost ₹1.40 Lakh with very low interest rate.
subsidy_info: Special low interest rate of 6.5% per annum.

name: Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY)
description: Comprehensive cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹5 Lakh per year per family for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation. Senior citizens aged 70+ get an exclusive separate ₹5 Lakh top-up cover via the Ayushman Vaya Vandana Card.
subsidy_info: 100% cashless treatment at all empaneled public and private hospitals across India.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Guaranteed monthly pension ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 post-60 years of age based on contribution amount, backed by Government of India.
subsidy_info: Government co-contribution for eligible subscribers. Subscriber receives life-long assured pension.

name: PM Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
description: Old age protection and social security scheme for unorganized workers. Assures a minimum monthly pension of ₹3,000 after attaining age 60 with 50:50 government matching contribution.
subsidy_info: 50% monthly contribution matched by Central Government into beneficiary pension account.

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
description: Solar rooftop subsidy scheme providing up to 300 units of free electricity per month. Central financial assistance: ₹30,000 for 1 kW, ₹60,000 for 2 kW, and up to ₹78,000 for 3 kW or higher systems.
required_documents: Proof of Roof Ownership / Property Tax
subsidy_info: Direct DBT subsidy into bank account: ₹30k (1 kW), ₹60k (2 kW), ₹78k (3 kW+). Concessional collateral-free bank loans available.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY 2.0)
description: Housing for All initiative providing interest subsidy up to ₹2.30 Lakh to ₹2.67 Lakh on home loans for EWS, LIG, and MIG families to purchase or construct their first pucca house.
required_documents: Affidavit stating no pucca house ownership anywhere in India
subsidy_info: Upfront interest subsidy credited directly to beneficiary loan account reducing principal and EMI.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
description: Provides free deposit-free LPG connection to adult women from BPL and disadvantaged households, along with a targeted subsidy of ₹300 per refill for up to 12 cylinders annually.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of applicant & family members
subsidy_info: Free stove + first cylinder connection deposit waiver + ₹300 subsidy per refill directly in bank account.

name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 directly transferred into the bank accounts of all landholding farmer families across India.
subsidy_info: 100% direct central government cash transfer via Aadhaar-linked DBT.

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
description: Comprehensive empowerment for 18 traditional artisan trades (carpenters, blacksmiths, goldsmiths, potters, etc.). Offers ₹15,000 modern toolkit e-voucher grant, ₹500/day training stipend, and collateral-free enterprise loans up to ₹3 Lakh at an ultra-low 5% interest rate.
subsidy_info: ₹15,000 toolkit grant + 8% interest subvention by Government ensuring effective interest rate is capped at just 5%.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
description: Loans up to ₹10 Lakh without collateral for micro and small enterprises across three stages: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishor (₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakh), and Tarun (₹5 Lakh to ₹10 Lakh).
required_documents: Bank Statements for the last 6 months
subsidy_info: No collateral or third-party guarantee required. Credit guarantee backed by CGFMU.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore for Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), and/or Women entrepreneurs to set up greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, agri-allied, or trading.
subsidy_info: Up to 25% margin money can be converged with central or state subsidy schemes.

name: PMEGP (Prime Minister's Employment Generation)
description: Credit-linked subsidy programme for setting up new micro-enterprises in manufacturing (up to ₹50 Lakh) or service sector (up to ₹20 Lakh). Provides heavy government capital subsidy on project cost.
subsidy_info: SC/ST/Women/OBC: 35% capital subsidy in rural areas, 25% in urban areas. General: 25% rural, 15% urban.

name: NSFDC Micro Finance Scheme (MFS)
description: Micro Finance Scheme for small-scale income generating activities exclusively for SC individuals. Project cost up to ₹1.40 Lakh with 90% loan assistance (max ₹1.25 Lakh) at 6.5% p.a. concessional rate.
subsidy_info: Statutory 90% loan assistance up to ₹1.25 Lakh. Quarterly repayment over 3 years with 3-month moratorium.

name: NSFDC Term Loan Scheme
description: Concessional term loan for income-generating activities costing from ₹1.40 Lakh up to ₹50.00 Lakh for SC entrepreneurs. Maximum loan assistance up to 90% of project cost (up to ₹45.00 Lakh) at 8.0% p.a.
subsidy_info: 90% project cost financing. Quarterly repayment over 7 years with 6-month moratorium (up to 12 months for plantation/construction).

name: NSFDC Aajeevika Micro-Finance Yojana
description: Micro finance credit assistance through Channel Partners and NBFC-MFIs for quick livelihood activities. Project cost up to ₹1.40 Lakh with loan assistance up to ₹1.25 Lakh at 15.0% p.a.
subsidy_info: Fast-track processing for immediate micro-livelihoods via empaneled NBFC-MFIs and SCAs.

name: NSFDC Udyam Nidhi Yojana (UNY)
description: Composite loan assistance for setting up micro-enterprises with project cost up to ₹5.00 Lakh. Maximum loan ₹4.50 Lakh at 13.0% (Co-operative Banks) to 15.0% (Small Finance Banks).
subsidy_info: Repayment over 5 years in quarterly or half-yearly installments with a 3-month moratorium period.

name: NSFDC Educational Loan Scheme (India)
description: Concessional education loan for SC students pursuing recognized full-time professional/technical courses in India. Up to ₹40.00 Lakh (90% of course fee) at 6.0% p.a. Special 0.5% interest rebate for female students (5.5% p.a.).
subsidy_info: Female beneficiaries receive an exclusive 0.5% interest rebate (effective 5.5% p.a.). Moratorium covers full course duration + 1 year.

name: NSFDC Educational Loan Scheme (Abroad)
description: Concessional education loan for SC students pursuing professional/technical higher education in approved institutions abroad. Up to ₹40.00 Lakh at 7.0% p.a. (6.5% p.a. for female students).
subsidy_info: Repayment tenure up to 12 years with course duration + 1 year moratorium. 0.5% rebate for women.

name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana (MYSY)
description: Flagship Gujarat Government higher education financial assistance scheme for students pursuing Medical (MBBS/BDS), Engineering, Pharmacy, Diploma, and Professional degree courses. Provides 50% tuition fee subsidy up to ₹2,00,000/yr, ₹1,200/month hostel allowance, and ₹10,000 book/equipment grant.
subsidy_info: 50% tuition subsidy (up to ₹2,00,000 for Medical, ₹50,000 for Engineering, ₹25,000 for Degree, ₹10,000 for Diploma) + ₹12,000/yr hostel lodging + ₹10,000 instrument grant.

name: Digital Gujarat Post-Matric Scholarship
description: Universal higher education scholarship portal by Government of Gujarat for SC, ST, and SEBC students enrolled in ITI, Polytechnic, Undergrad, Postgraduate, and PhD courses. Reimburses 100% compulsory tuition and examination fees plus monthly maintenance stipends.
subsidy_info: 100% tuition and examination fee waiver directly credited to Aadhaar-seeded bank account via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) plus monthly maintenance allowance.

name: Dr. Ambedkar Foreign Study Loan (Gujarat GSCDC)
description: Concessional foreign study loan administered by Gujarat Scheduled Castes Development Corporation (GSCDC) for SC students pursuing postgraduate diplomas, Master's degrees, or PhD programs in accredited universities abroad.
subsidy_info: Concessional 4.0% interest rate (3.5% for female students). Repayment begins 1 year after graduation or 6 months after securing employment.

name: Kanya Kelavani Nidhi Higher Education Grant
description: Specialized Gujarat state education welfare scheme providing full financial tuition grant to female students from backward and economically weaker classes admitted to recognized medical, engineering, nursing, and professional institutes in Gujarat.
subsidy_info: 100% financial tuition grant / interest-free financial support for female students throughout the course duration.

name: Central Sector Interest Subsidy (CSIS) on Education Loans
description: Ministry of Education (Govt. of India) scheme providing full 100% interest subsidy during the moratorium period (course tenure + 1 year) on educational loans availed from scheduled banks for professional and technical courses in India.
subsidy_info: 100% interest subsidy reimbursed by Central Government during study and 1-year moratorium, leaving zero interest payable by student during studies.

name: PM SVANidhi (PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
description: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs micro-credit facility empowering urban street vendors, hawkers, thela-walas, and micro-traders. Offers collateral-free working capital in 3 progressive tranches: ₹10,000 (1st), ₹20,000 (2nd), and up to ₹50,000 (3rd tranche). Features an attractive 7% interest subsidy on regular repayments and up to ₹1,200/year cashback on digital UPI transactions.
required_documents: Vending Certificate / Urban Local Body (ULB) Identity Card
Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from Town Vending Committee (TVC)
subsidy_info: 7% interest subsidy directly credited quarterly via DBT. Monthly digital cashback up to ₹100 for digital UPI transactions (up to ₹1,200 annually).

name: Mahila Samriddhi Yojana (NSFDC MSY)
description: NSFDC's flagship micro-credit assistance exclusively for Scheduled Caste women entrepreneurs and self-help groups. Provides financial support up to ₹1,40,000 per woman at a highly subsidized 3.50% effective interest rate (4.0% statutory rate with automatic 0.50% female rebate). Includes a 6-month moratorium to assist business ramp-up.
subsidy_info: Effective 3.50% p.a. interest rate with female concession. Up to 100% project cost covered without mandatory promoter margin money.

name: Shri Vajpayee Bankable Yojana (Gujarat SVBY)
description: Cottage and Village Industries Department (Government of Gujarat) scheme designed to generate self-employment for urban and rural unemployed individuals, artisans, and service providers. Provides financial assistance up to ₹8.00 Lakh for industries, ₹8.00 Lakh for services, and ₹4.00 Lakh for retail businesses, with generous capital subsidies up to 40% (max ₹1.25 Lakh) for SC/ST and women applicants.
subsidy_info: SC/ST/Women/Minority: 40% subsidy in rural areas (max ₹1,25,000) and 37.5% in urban areas (max ₹1,00,000). General category: 25% (max ₹1,00,000 rural, ₹80,000 urban).

name: PM Formalisation of Micro food processing Enterprises (PMFME)
description: Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI) flagship initiative under Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan. Provides 35% credit-linked capital subsidy (up to ₹10.00 Lakh) for establishment or upgradation of micro food processing units (e.g. spice grinding, flour mill, pickle & chutney, dairy products, bakery, oil expeller, fruit pulp processing).
subsidy_info: 35% credit-linked capital subsidy of eligible project cost with a maximum ceiling of ₹10,00,000 per enterprise. Beneficiary contribution is minimum 10%.

name: Dhibar Yojana (Fisheries & Water Body Livelihood)
description: NSFDC specialized financial assistance scheme supporting traditional fisheries, aquaculture, and water-body based livelihoods for Scheduled Caste families. Provides concessional financing up to ₹15.00 Lakh at 6.00% p.a. (5.50% p.a. for fisherwomen) with seasonal 6-9 months moratorium for procurement of fiberglass boats, mechanized engines, fishing nets, and cold storage iceboxes.
subsidy_info: Concessional 6.0% p.a. interest rate with 0.5% female rebate (5.50% p.a.). Seasonal moratorium aligns with breeding and monsoon ban periods.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC - Animal Husbandry & Dairy)
description: Government of India subsidized short-term working capital credit for dairy farmers, goat rearing, poultry, and animal husbandry producers. Loan limit up to ₹2.00 Lakh with zero collateral at an effective interest rate of 4.00% p.a. (7% base rate with 3% prompt repayment incentive).
required_documents: Veterinary Certificate & Animal Health / Tagging Record
subsidy_info: Effective interest rate of only 4% per annum upon prompt yearly repayment (Government provides 3% prompt repayment interest subvention).

name: Mukhyamantri Mahila Utkarsh Yojana (MMUY Gujarat)
description: Gujarat state scheme providing 0% interest loans up to ₹1,00,000 to Joint Liability and Self-Help Groups (JLGs) of women in urban and rural areas. The entire bank interest is borne directly by the Gujarat State Government as an interest subsidy, enabling women to start home-based enterprises and handicraft trades.
subsidy_info: 100% interest subsidy paid directly to financing bank by Gujarat State Government; loan is completely interest-free (0% interest) for beneficiaries.

name: National SC-ST Hub (NSSH) Special Capital Subsidy (SCLCSS)
description: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) flagship scheme offering 25% upfront capital subsidy (up to ₹25.00 Lakh) on institutional credit availed by SC/ST entrepreneurs for procurement of modern plant, machinery, testing equipment, and technology upgrade.
subsidy_info: 25% upfront capital subsidy on plant & machinery purchase up to a ceiling of ₹25 Lakh directly credited to borrower's term loan account.
